historical_record.description: The Art Commission approved the final working drawings for the building of the Hamilton Recreation Center, designed by William G. Merchant, Architect.
Hamilton Playground, on Geary between Steiner and Scott, was dedicated, according to the official list of 1947 recreation bond playgrounds the Recreation and Park Commission entered in its minutes.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to build the Hamilton Recreation Center to M & K Corporation at $543,169, the lowest of six bids.
